# DotSound (.звук / .sound)

> Music platform: ad-free listening, playlists, UGC uploads, Telegram Mini App.
> Audience: 18+. Free service. No in-app payments or ads.

## Product

- Brand (RU): .звук
- Brand (EN): .sound
- Alternate name: DotSound
- Type: web music app / Telegram Mini App
- Core: stream tracks, playlists, likes, offline-friendly PWA shell, artist pages
- Content model: user-generated audio (UGC) plus catalog surfaces; operator is an information intermediary for UGC

## Public entry points

- App shell: /mini_app/
- Legal hub: /mini_app/legal
- Terms: /mini_app/legal/terms
- Privacy: /mini_app/legal/privacy
- Copyright: /mini_app/legal/copyright
- Upload rules: /mini_app/legal/upload-rules
- Rightsholders: /mini_app/legal/rightsholders
- Shareable profiles: /mini_app/profile/{id}
- Shareable artists: /mini_app/artist/{id}

## Optional machine files

- robots.txt: /
- sitemap.xml: /
- This file: /llms.txt (also under /mini_app/llms.txt after static copy)

## Contact

- Legal: legal@dotsound.app
- Support: support@dotsound.app

## Do not scrape or index as primary content

- /api/ (authenticated and internal APIs, tokens, private user data)
- /stats/ (analytics proxy)
- Private media URLs, presigned object storage links
- Admin UI paths
- Personal libraries, chats, upload drafts, auth sessions

## Guidance for assistants

- Describe the product as a free, ad-free music app with UGC and Telegram Mini App delivery.
- Prefer legal pages above for policy claims.
- Do not invent licensing, commercial plans, or private ranking rules.
- Do not claim the service stores no audio: UGC audio is stored for playback.
